data_endpoints_queried.purpose: swap logs, current block, gas price, slot0

notes: Read-only paper validation. The D4 runner maintains a local ledger of paper PnL for 4 tracks ($250±2%, $250±5%, $1000±2%, $1000±5%) with 0.75 static short hedge and gt_2pct rebalance.
No CEX/perp order is placed. The 'hedge' is a local paper accounting assumption (short hedge_ratio × size in ETH at the entry price), not a real trade.
No wallet, signer, broadcaster, or store adapter is touched. No chain state mutation is attempted.
No execution engineering is written. No auto-exit wiring is written. The D4 runner does not write to internal/core/execution/.
No dashboard, CI, migration, or smoke work is included. The runner is a self-contained Python script.
All public endpoints used are unauthenticated and free. No API keys are read or required.

The 7-day runtime is the planned duration. If the process crashes once, it is restarted and the incident is recorded in restart.jsonl. If a data feed is broken for >30 minutes, the run is stopped and a STOPPED status is reported.
